Meta.title: ExecAtlas: senior engineering leadership jobs worldwide
Meta.description: Director, VP and CTO roles across India, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, North Africa, Europe and North America. Real apply links, visa sponsorship signals and local-currency pay bands.
Meta.jobsDescription: Filter senior engineering leadership roles by region, visa sponsorship, work mode and role type.
Meta.aboutDescription: How ExecAtlas sources roles, detects visa sponsorship and estimates salaries in local currency.

Home.heroSubtitle: One place to find Director, VP, Head of and CTO roles across India, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, North Africa, Europe and North America. Real apply links, visa signals, and pay bands in local currency.
Home.featureVisaBody: Each posting is read for sponsorship language, so you can filter straight to roles that sponsor work visas and skip the ones that say no.
Home.featurePayBody: Stated salaries are shown as posted. When a posting hides the number, an estimated band from curated country benchmarks fills the gap, always labeled as an estimate.
Home.featureApplyBody: Every role links to the employer's own posting. No middlemen, no re-hosted forms, no expired aggregator pages.
Home.sourcesNote: Sourced from official and public job APIs. Details on the About page.

About.title: About ExecAtlas
About.intro: ExecAtlas collects senior engineering leadership roles from official and public job APIs, reads every posting for signals that matter to international candidates, and presents them with filters and local-currency pay context.
About.sourcesBody: Listings come from the public Greenhouse Job Board API, Workable's public job search, and the open APIs of Arbeitnow and Jobicy. Each listing links to the employer's own posting.
About.blockedTitle: Why no LinkedIn, Indeed or Naukri jobs?
About.blockedBody: Those sites do not offer public job APIs and their terms do not allow automated collection. Scraping them is not something this project does. If any of them opens an official access path, a connector slot is ready. Many employers post the same roles on their own Greenhouse or Workable boards, which this site does cover.
About.visaBody: Every posting text is scanned for sponsorship language such as visa sponsorship, work permit or relocation support, and for explicit refusals such as must have existing right to work. Postings that say nothing are marked Unspecified rather than guessed.
About.salaryBody: When a posting states a range, it is shown as stated. Otherwise an estimated band is computed from ExpatRate's curated country benchmarks for senior technology roles, always in the local currency of the job's country, and always labeled as an estimate.
About.limitsBody: Estimates are orientation, not offers. Visa detection reads words, not immigration policy. Some countries have thin benchmark data and will show no estimate. The about page will always be honest about gaps.

Footer.tagline: Senior engineering leadership roles across six regions, with visa signals and local pay context.
Footer.data: Job data from the official and public APIs of Greenhouse, Workable, Arbeitnow and Jobicy.
